ModuleTitle.helper: Used to sync with the system's module title. This does not display to site visitors. It makes it useful to restore content, if/when needed.
ModuleTitle.placeholder: Try entering anything that's somewhat unique

ModuleAnchor.helper: Used to create #anchor-links on the page (numbers, letters, hyphens only).

Title.helper: Enter the title to use in this template. Use clear wording that visitors will understand.

Description.helper: Enter the text for description. Use short paragraphs so it is easy to read.

AltText.helper: Describe the image for people who use screen readers. Leave this blank only when the image is decorative.

VideoId.helper: It's the value in the web addresses that looks funky, like https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=KXC4fqcYMXA

UploadDate.helper: Choose the date or time to use for upload date.

Duration.helper: Enter the duration to use in this template. Use clear wording that visitors will understand.

IsShort.helper: If it's a short, then it's basically a vertical TikTok or Instagram reel.

VideoList.helper: Add and arrange the items used for video list. Remove any item you do not need.
